artworks.title: Ordnance, Sergeant
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a formal pose. He stands upright with both hands resting on a sword held in front of him. His facial features include a full beard and mustache, and he has short dark hair partially covered by a hat. The hat is dark with a decorative emblem in the center. He is dressed in a military uniform consisting of a dark blue coat with red chevrons and insignias on the sleeves, and light blue trousers with a red stripe running down the side. The coat has brass buttons and he sports a sash over his shoulder, complemented by a belt with a metallic buckle. He is also wearing white gloves. Around him are military items, including a stack of drums with an eagle emblem, several rifles, swords, and what appears to be a rolled-up blanket. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall.

artworks.title: Rubber Poncho
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro

artworks.title: With Pride Upon Her Brow
artworks.medium: black chalk, pen and black ink, grey wash and heightened with white on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen in Memory of Heidi L. Berry
artworks.description: This painting depicts several figures and a pig on a wooden porch. The woman in the foreground is wearing a long dress and bonnet, standing on a wooden boardwalk. In the background, several figures are seated on a porch attached to a wooden building. One figure leans against a pillar, while another sits on the steps of the porch. Two children are bent down on the ground on the left side of the painting. A pig is in the darkened doorway behind the woman. The painting uses monochrome shades and brown tones, giving it a vintage or historical feel and emphasizing textures. The style is reminiscent of Edwin Austin Abbey.

artworks.title: Corpo di Cava
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor, heightened with white gouache on brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint, showing a hillside with scattered trees. The horizon is near the top, revealing distant mountains framing the sky. The artwork has a loose style with pencil sketches and varied brushstrokes. Earthy browns and muted greens dominate the color palette, with white highlights indicating sunlight. The scene includes paths, structures, rolling hills, and distant mountains.

artworks.title: Moonlit River Landscape
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nocturnal landscape with a riverside view. The sky is starry and the horizon is partially covered by trees. A bright full moon is above the horizon, reflecting on the water. The painting is detailed, showing textures in the foliage and sky. In the foreground, a horse grazes by the riverbank next to a small building. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white shades to depict the contrasts of a moonlit night.

artworks.title: Farm Landscape with Hunters and Milkmaids
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert, after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a countryside landscape with a detailed view. The horizon is positioned near the top third of the image, showcasing large trees and the sky. Cows are present throughout the landscape, along with two people and a dog on the left side. Additionally, a few women are depicted tending to cows further in the distance. The etching displays intricate lines for texture and depth, utilizing cross-hatching for shading. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray, creating contrast. A house is visible in the distance, surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Drapery Study (verso)
artworks.medium: red chalk, with touches of black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a draped fabric or cloth detail. The image captures the folds and curves of the material. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic sepia tone. The background is off-white. The study showcases the artist's skill in capturing the fluidity and complexity of drapery.

artworks.title: Studies of Clouds and an Old Woman
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on two sheets of wove paper (non-consecutive sketchbook pages)
artworks.description: There is a sketch showing two separate scenes on the same page. The left side shows a landscape with loose, sweeping lines. The right side depicts figures with simple, curved lines. Handwritten notes at the top include words like "Hotel Grand-maison" and "Barbier." The color palette is monochromatic with graphite pencil on off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Pont d'Alma at Twilight
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache, with abrading and scraping, pen and black ink, with touches of graphite on pale gray, multi-color fiber, wove paper; laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with a bridge in the distance, a barge on the water with colored lights, and a hazy, misty atmosphere. Brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, creating a dreamlike quality. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of green, yellow, and brown. outlines of vegetation and a path suggest a riverbank, with trees barely discernible against the blurred background.

artworks.title: Dunkerque
artworks.medium: watercolor, black chalk and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Roy and Cecily Langdale Davis in memory of Margaret and Raymond J. Horowitz
artworks.description: The image shows a tall clock tower in an urban setting. The tower dominates the composition, with buildings and a bustling street in the foreground. Architectural details are visible, including shops with signs that read "TABAC" and partial letters over an entrance. Loose and fluid brushstrokes create a sense of movement. The color palette is muted with browns, beiges, and greys, accented by occasional touches of blue and red. The sky above appears overcast with soft brushwork indicating a cloudy day.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: tintype with applied color
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated and facing the camera. Her upper body, including her chest and head, is in focus. She has distinct facial features, dark hair styled with waves and curls, and is wearing a dark dress with ornate details and a high collar. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is directly facing the viewer, with her hair styled in two long braids adorned with curls, framing her face on either side. Her facial features include a straight expression, with prominent eyebrows and well-defined lips. She is wearing a high-collared blouse with lace detailing and a darkly colored garment over it, featuring intricate patterns. A brooch is clipped at the center of her collar, and delicate ribbons appear tied around her neck. The background of the image is plain, with a neutral tone that softly transitions from dark to light shading, and there is an oval vignette surrounding the figure. The borders of the photograph have signs of age, with some visible strokes and markings around the edges.

artworks.title: The Tournament
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Florian Carr Fund and Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an indoor tennis tournament. It depicts an indoor sports setting, potentially a tennis court, with spectators around the perimeter watching the game. People are shown in different poses, indicating engagement and interest. There is a sense of movement and activity, with figures either participating or observing closely. The background features detailed structures, and shading adds depth to the scene. The atmosphere seems lively, and the overall composition is dynamic, capturing a moment in a sport and social event.

artworks.title: The Lion Gardiner House, Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Florian Carr Fund and Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a two-story house surrounded by mature trees. There is no horizon visible. The house and trees are depicted in a detailed line drawing style with intricate cross-hatching and fine lines for depth and shadow. The artwork is monochromatic using black ink on a light background. Sunlight filters through the leaves creating patterns on the house. A person stands near the entrance of the house. Dense foliage frames the house, filled with intricate details.

artworks.title: Washington's Birthday—Fifth Avenue & 23rd Street
artworks.medium: etching in black
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Florian Carr Fund and Gift of the Print Research Foundation
artworks.description: This image depicts a street-level view of a urban avenue surrounded by tall buildings. A prominent skyscraper stands out in the distance. The buildings and architectural details are suggested with expressive lines. The drawing is done using fine, delicate strokes, creating an impressionistic texture. The color palette is monochromatic, varying in shades of grey. The sky blends softly with the skyscraper. The scene below shows a busy city street with cars and tiny figures.

artworks.title: Ex Libris C. Patel
artworks.medium: intaglio
artworks.dimensions:
image: 11.5 x 8.5 cm (4 1/2 x 3 3/8 in.)
stone: 22.9 cm
artworks.description: This abstract artwork features flowing and curved lines forming the body of a reclining figure with a flower-like head. The figure appears to rest or lean with one arm on an oversized book, the pages cascading around the form like drapery. The background is textured with a crosshatch pattern.

artworks.title: Sun Breaking through Clouds above the Roman Campagna
artworks.medium: oil on paper mounted on a second sheet and then on canvas
artworks.dimensions: stretcher size: 29 x 44 cm (11 7/16 x 17 5/16 in.)

artworks.title: Nynee Tall from South End
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated point overlooking a landscape. There are trees of varying heights in the foreground, with a tall, slender tree slightly off-center on the right side. The terrain slopes downward to a path where faint figures can be seen sitting and walking. Beyond the path is a body of water, likely a lake or river, surrounded by hills and clusters of trees. In the distance are softly undulating mountains against a hazy, light-toned sky. The color palette is monochrome with sepia tones, giving the impression of an antique photograph. The composition conveys depth and tranquility.

artworks.title: The Assumption and Coronation of the Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with stumped graphite over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a detailed drawing showing various figures. In the central part of the composition, three primary figures are depicted. One, a woman, is shown in full, kneeling, with her hands clasped, wearing a long flowing robe that drapes around her. Her hair is covered with a fabric. To her left, a muscular male figure is positioned standing on clouds, leaning slightly forward. This male figure is largely undraped, with a cloth around his waist and a crown upon his head, extending his arms to hold a crown above the woman. To the woman's right, another male figure stands, extending his hands to support the placement of the crown on the woman's head. This figure is depicted wearing a long robe, a large cloak, and a mitre on his head, with long hair and a beard. The surrounding environment is filled with numerous cherubs and angels, some playing instruments, some observing, and others positioned in various dynamic poses. The cherubs and angels are amidst swirling clouds, forming an arched frame around the central scene. The background features more clouds and heavenly figures, creating a sense of elevation and divinity in the scene.

artworks.title: Moses Drawing Water From the Rock
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with black wash and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding large urns with flowing liquid. The artwork features interactions between the figures and the urns, as they appear engaged in a communal activity. The scene is chaotic, with dynamic gestures and overlapping figures. The drawing is done in a style resembling Renaissance or Baroque styles, with dramatic poses and interactions. The sepia-toned colors enhance the historical feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Two Figures Fishing in a Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a small human figure standing among trees. The horizon is not clearly defined, blending the treetops with the sky. The brushstrokes depict the foliage with swirls and dabs. The color palette consists of sepia tones. Trees curve gracefully with detailed trunks and branches. Some trees closer to us have gnarled roots and textured bark. Trees in the distance are less detailed, creating depth in the landscape.

artworks.title: A Seated Soldier
artworks.medium: black chalk over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil drawing of a man from mid-thigh upwards. He is leaning back on his left hand while holding a stick with a string or strap attached in his right hand. The man's head is turned to his right, and he has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He is wearing a military-style cap, a high-collared shirt, and a jacket with epaulets on the shoulders. There are buttons running down the front of the jacket. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Death of Sapphira
artworks.artist: Follower of Jan de Bisschop, after Guercino
artworks.medium: brush and brown wash with black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in full-body view engaging in dynamic interaction. The central person is leaning forward with an arm outstretched towards another figure. This central figure has a prominent beard and hair, suggesting a mature male, and is wearing draped robes. The individual on the left is shown from the back, in a lively posture with arms raised, wearing a gown that flows with their movement and hair pulled back in a bun. The third figure stands to the right, partially visible with hands raised, appearing to be an older male with a bald head and draped garments. The background has sketchy architectural features and a cloudy sky. No jewelry or objects are depicted.

artworks.title: Saint Bernard of Clairvaux with the Instruments of the Passion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash and black chalk, incised for transfer on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man from the waist up. He is in a three-quarter view, looking down. The man has a receding hairline and is wearing a religious robe. In his hands, he holds a bundle of straw-like objects tied together, a large wooden cross, elongated objects, a large key, and a rosary. There is a faint halo around his head. In the background, there is a cloth with a face drawn on it, a column with a rooster on top, a ladder, and an open book in the foreground. The drawing is monochromatic, emphasizing contour and shading.
